event.subtitle: The Crucible
event.tagline: Be prepared for a wild ride
event.characterCreationNote: Ready? Sign up and wait for your realm assignment.
lore: Welcome to the Readathon 2026. All the realms have been destroyed - you are being forced into The Crucible, a deadly competition where it's your character class against every other character class.
The strongest will put their books (and lives) on the line to gain points, leveling themselves and their team up while sabotaging the points of other teams.

howItWorks.title: Join the Readathon
howItWorks.body: Login with your google account or your email that you entered into the Google Form. If you are not sure which email you used, ask Ashlay or Millie.

howItWorks.title: Read & submit
howItWorks.body: Finish a book, then use the submission form. Pick up to {maxPrompts} prompts, all positive or all negative per book.

howItWorks.title: Add or sabotage
howItWorks.body: Help your team's points or attack another realm. One book can only do one, not both.

howItWorks.title: Layer bonuses
howItWorks.body: Team prompts, page-count bonuses, and competition/trials stack on top of your {maxPrompts} prompts.

howItWorks.title: Double-check
howItWorks.body: Submissions cannot be edited by readers. Review carefully before you submit.

faq.q: Can I use more than one prompt?
faq.a: Yes, up to {maxPrompts} prompts per book, not including bonus prompts. They must all be increasing OR all decreasing.
If you think it counts, count it. If you think it doesn't, don't. Use your discretion.

faq.q: Do I have to read my realm's bonus prompts?
faq.a: No, they're optional extras for people who want them.

faq.q: How do I track my reads?
faq.a: Use the submission form on this site after your team is assigned.

faq.q: How many times can bonus prompts be used?
faq.a: As many times as you'd like.
Yes, use them as much as you'd like.
One book attacks one realm. Your next book can target a different realm.

faq.q: Can one book both increase and decrease?
faq.a: No, one book does one or the other.

faq.q: Is there a minimum number of prompts?
faq.a: No, do as many or as few as you'd like.

faq.q: Do manga or graphic novels count?
faq.a: Yes, any form of reading counts.

faq.q: Can a book started in the first month, but finished in another month count?
faq.a: Use your discretion. If you only read 10 pages in another month, probably not. A good chunk in that specific month - sure.

faq.q: Can a book be a re-read?

faq.a: Use your discretion - if you read a good chunk of that book, sure.

faq.q: Audiobooks - how to calculate page count?
faq.a: Use the Goodreads page count. If there is none, use 40 pages per hour that you listened.
Readers can't edit after submitting - double-check it before you submit it.

faq.q: Do bonus prompts count toward the {maxPrompts} prompts?
faq.a: No, you get {maxPrompts} prompts, then bonuses layer on top.
